title: T199 · Financial Covenant Compliance Checker
description: Input covenant terms and current financial metrics to check compliance and calculate headroom to breach. Covers leverage, interest cover, liquidity, and custom covenants. Stress-test headroom under revenue and margin shocks. Client-side. Zero PII.
